root.label: Gen. Dan Caine letter on military at 2026 polling places

events.label: Gen. Dan Caine letter on military at 2026 polling places

slots.name: deployment status
slots.sentence: Democrats have pressed the administration for assurances that Trump won't send troops to the polls, prompting Joint Chiefs of Staff Chairman Gen. Dan Caine to respond with a letter saying there are "no plans to send Federal military personnel or Federalized members of the National Guard to polling places during the 2026 elections."
